description: Answer "why was/wasn't dependency X updated?" from an existing `dry_run` report — offline, no CLI. Finds every extracted occurrence of the dependency under `packageFiles` (matched case-insensitively against `depName` and `packageName`; exact by default, `partial: true` for substring) and returns per hit its `skipReason` / `skipStage`, proposed `updates`, and `warnings`, plus a one-line `verdict` (`not found in report`, `skipped: <reason>`, `up to date`, or `N update(s) available`), remedy `hints`, and `relatedProblems` (report/repo `problems` entries mentioning the dep). Pass the report inline (`report`, raw or a full `dry_run` summary) via `reportPath` (pair with `dry_run`'s reportOutputPath) or as `logPath` (a Renovate JSON-lines debug log from a real bot run, `LOG_LEVEL=debug LOG_FORMAT=json`). Optionally add a config source (`repoPath` or `configContent`) to attach `matchedRules` — the packageRules that matched each hit, evaluated with Renovate's real matchers in a worker thread.

configContent.description: Inline config object whose packageRules to attribute against. Use instead of repoPath.

depName.description: Dependency to explain; compared case-insensitively against each dep's `depName` and `packageName`.

logPath.description: Absolute path to a Renovate JSON-lines debug log from a real run (`LOG_LEVEL=debug LOG_FORMAT=json`), read as a report. Use instead of report / reportPath.

manager.description: Only consider deps extracted by this manager (e.g. `npm`, `dockerfile`).

partial.description: When true, substring match instead of exact. Default false.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the repository root; the tool locates and expands its renovate config to attach matchedRules. Use instead of configContent.

report.description: A Renovate dry-run report — the raw report (`{ repositories }`) or a full `dry_run` summary (`{ report }`); the tool unwraps `report` automatically. Use instead of reportPath.

reportPath.description: Absolute path to a JSON file containing the report (pair with `dry_run`'s reportOutputPath). Use instead of report.

name: explain_dependency
title: Explain why a dependency was or wasn't updated
